highlights: Each fight is described by what was known on the morning of the fight: only earlier fights count, never its own result or anything after it.
It was tested on the newest fights, all later than every fight it trained on, and its confidence was calibrated on a separate block in between.
Every probability is the average of both fighter orders, so it does not change with who is listed first.
SHAP shows which stats pushed each prediction toward one fighter or the other.
limitations: Only past UFC fights are counted. A fighter's record in other organizations is not in the model, so a debutant is read from age, height and reach alone.
Striking and takedown history only exists for fights with published statistics; where it is missing, the model fills in typical values.
Fights are hard to call: a pick is an estimate, and upsets are common.
This is a personal project for learning, not betting advice.
model.metrics_note: Measured once on 1,755 fights (June 2023 to October 2026), all later than the fights it trained on, each fighter described as of the morning of the fight. It picked the winner 62.7% of the time; its confidence was calibrated on a separate block of earlier fights.
